description: Source code for ARC4 encryption driver in Linux kernel, implementing ARC4 cipher and skcipher algorithms, including initialization, key setting, encryption/decryption functions, and driver registration.

methods.name: _deu_arc4
methods.description: Main interface to ARC4 hardware for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: arc4_set_key_skcipher
methods.description: Sets the ARC4 key for skcipher.

methods.name: _deu_arc4_ecb
methods.description: Configures ARC4 hardware to ECB mode for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: arc4_crypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts a block of data with ARC4.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_arc4
methods.description: Initializes and registers ARC4 driver algorithms.
